reports.text:
This week felt mostly in the middle, tipping toward hard. I played every day, and I got 76 right out of 153 cards, so about half. Typed meaning was my comfort zone, 25 of 35, and cloze typed and sentence translation also went fine. Multiple choice was rough at 9 of 27, listen choice only 4 of 12, and cloze choice 0 of 3, which stung.

Words did come back on later days, like пожалуйста, можешь and сказать, which helped. But none repeated within one session, so I never got a second try right away.

What bothers me most is the forgotten words nobody asked about: порядке, день, после, всего, лет, боже, сэр, мистер, жизнь, потом, такой, всех. I saved 53 new words, and these just vanished. Also, 9 spoken answers went unheard and 4 cards didn't match any saved word.

Week 2 felt mixed, mostly medium with a few hard spots. I played all 7 days, and 99 right out of 160 cards is okay. Typed meaning and multiple choice were fine, but read aloud was brutal at 1 of 13, and 13 of my spoken answers were not heard, so I suspect the app's listening is part of it. Typed translation was also tough at 5 of 13.

The same word never repeated within a session, so nothing felt nagging. Some words did return after a gap: можешь after 6 days, делать and сказать after 4. That spacing felt right.

What bothers me is the forgotten words nobody asked: порядке, день, после, всего, лет, боже, сэр, мистер, жизнь, потом, такой, всех. They slipped away and never came back. Also, 6 cards could not be matched to a saved word, which felt odd. I saved 24 new words, but I want the old ones back.

This week felt mostly too hard for me, especially the speaking and listening cards. I got only 4 of 15 right on say translation, 1 of 5 on listen choice, and 2 of 9 on dictation. Typing translations went well, 10 of 11, so reading and writing feel okay. Matching and multiple choice were middling.

I never saw the same word twice in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Old words like всегда, пожалуйста and похоже did come back after a long gap, which was good.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked about: порядке, день, после, всего, лет, боже, сэр, мистер, жизнь, потом, такой, всех. They never returned, so I couldn't fix them.

The app also missed 2 of my spoken answers, and 19 cards couldn't be matched to a saved word, which was frustrating.

This week felt mostly manageable, but a bit uneven. I played every day and got 111 right out of 170 cards, so I was winning more than losing. Typed meaning and typed translation felt comfortable. Matching was the rough one, 26 of 44, and multiple choice was only 12 of 21. Read aloud was shaky too, 5 of 9, and say translation was hard, 4 of 8.

Nothing repeated inside a session, which I liked. It never felt like the same word again and again.

What bothers me is the gaps. дело only came back after 17 days, and значит after 16. Meanwhile порядке, день, после, всего, лет, жизнь and потом were forgotten and no card asked about them. They just vanished.

Four spoken answers weren't heard, and 11 cards didn't match any saved word. That was annoying.

This week felt mixed, leaning hard in places. Typed meaning and matching were fine, and multiple choice was easy, but read aloud was rough: I got 2 right out of 13, and say translation was 2 of 6. Thirteen of my spoken answers weren't heard, so I can't tell how much was my Russian and how much was the app. Letter tiles went 0 of 2.

I never saw the same word twice in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Some old words did return, like иди and говорит after 15 days, and вместе and доктор after 12, which was nice.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked about: порядке, день, после, всего, лет, боже, сэр, мистер, жизнь, потом, такой, всех. They never came back. Also, 16 cards couldn't be matched to a saved word, so my progress feels a bit blurry.
